mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN A.CMCDKY IS NULL THEN 'MASTER_M0097' || ' ' || STD.CMCDKY ELSE 'OK' END AS MSG FROM ( ${VALIDATION_SQL} ) STD LEFT OUTER JOIN CMCDM A ON A.CMCDKY = STD.CMCDKY WHERE A.CMCDKY IS NULL

SELECT CASE WHEN A.CMCDVL IS NULL THEN 'MASTER_M0097' || ' ' || STD.CMCDVL ELSE 'OK' END AS MSG FROM (${VALIDATION_SQL}) STD LEFT OUTER JOIN CMCDV A ON A.CMCDKY = STD.CMCDKY AND A.CMCDVL = STD.CMCDVL WHERE A.CMCDVL IS NULL

SELECT Q020.INSP_ITEM_GRP_CD AS "INSP_ITEM_GRP_CD" , Q020.MATNR AS "MATNR" -- 자재코드 , M001.MATNR_NM AS "MATNR_NM" -- 자재명 , Q020.WERKS AS "WERKS" -- 플랜트 , Q020.MSRM_DATE AS "MSRM_DATE" -- 측정일시 , Q020.PRC_SEQNO AS "PRC_SEQNO" -- 처리순번(H) , NVL((SELECT NMLAST FROM USRMA WHERE USRMA.USERID = Q020.MSRM_ID),'') AS "MSRM_NM" , Q020.SMPL_AMT AS "SMPL_AMT" -- 시료량(H) ,(SELECT CDESC1 FROM CMCDV WHERE CMCDKY = 'FNL_JDGM' AND CMCDVL = Q020.FNL_JDGM) AS "FNL_JDGM_NM" , Q020.LOT_NO AS "LOT_NO" -- 로트번호 , Q020.IND_BCD AS "IND_BCD" -- 개별바코드 , Q020.VND_LOT_NO AS "VND_LOT_NO" -- 공급업체 로트번호 , Q020.SUPY_VND_BCD AS "SUPY_VND_BCD" -- 공급업체 바코드 , Q020.UCFMTY_AMT AS "UCFMTY_AMT" -- 부적합량 , W501.WRK_ORDR_NO AS "WRK_ORDR_NO" -- 작업지시번호 , W501.WRK_ORDR_SEQNO AS "WRK_ORDR_SEQNO" -- 작업지시번호순번 , W501.MACH_CD AS "MACH_CD" -- 설비코드(H) , NVL((SELECT MACH_NM FROM TB_MAS012 WHERE MACH_CD = W501.MACH_CD ),'') AS "MACH_NM" , (SELECT SUM(DECODE(UNIT, 'PAL', PLT_QTY, 'ROL', PLT_QTY, 'BOX', BOX_QTY, 'BAG', BAG_QTY, 'EA', EA_QTY)) FROM TB_WRK001 WHERE WERKS = W501.WERKS AND LOT_NO = W501.LOT_NO AND WRK_ORDR_NO = W501.WRK_ORDR_NO AND WRK_ORDR_SEQNO = W501.WRK_ORDR_SEQNO) AS "PRFM_QTY" -- 실적수량 , Q020.APVR_STA AS "APVR_STA" -- 결재상태 , Q020.CFRM_ID AS "CFRM_ID" -- 승인자 , Q020.CFRM_DATE AS "CFRM_DATE" -- 승인일시 , Q020.REGDATE , NVL((SELECT NMLAST FROM USRMA WHERE USRMA.USERID = Q020.REGID),'') AS "REGNM" , Q020.UPDDATE , NVL((SELECT NMLAST FROM USRMA WHERE USRMA.USERID = Q020.UPDID),'') AS "UPDNM" FROM TB_QLT020 Q020, TB_MAS001 M001, TB_WRK501 W501, TB_WRK001 W001 WHERE Q020.WERKS = W501.WERKS(+) AND Q020.LOT_NO = W501.LOT_NO(+) AND Q020.MATNR = M001.MATNR(+) AND Q020.WERKS = M001.WERKS(+) AND Q020.WERKS = W001.WERKS(+) AND Q020.MATNR = W001.MATNR(+) AND Q020.LOT_NO = W001.LOT_NO(+) AND Q020.IND_BCD = W001.IND_BCD(+)
SELECT 'M' || LTRIM(RTRIM(TO_CHAR(SEQ_APPR_DOC_NO.NEXTVAL, '00000000'))) AS DOC_ID FROM DUAL

SELECT INV001.WERKS WERKS --플랜트코드 , INV001.IND_BCD IND_BCD --개별바코드 , INV001.STOR_LOC_CD STOR_LOC_CD --저장위치 , MAS003.STOR_LOC_NM STOR_LOC_NM --저장위치명 , INV001.MATNR MATNR --자재코드 , MAS001.MATNR_NM MATNR_NM --자재명 , INV001.LOT_NO LOT_NO --LOT NO , INV001.STCK_QTY STCK_QTY --재고수량 , INV001.UNIT UNIT --단위 , INV001.DOC_ID , NVL(INV001.APVR_STA, '0') APVR_STA --결재상태 , FN_CD_VAL('APVR_STA', NVL(INV001.APVR_STA,'0')) APVR_STA_NM --결재상태 FROM TB_INV001 INV001 --창고별 재고현황 , TB_MAS001 MAS001 --플랜트별 제품/자재 마스터 , TB_MAS003 MAS003 --저장위치 마스터(공정창고내 저장위치 포함) WHERE INV001.MATNR = MAS001.MATNR(+) AND INV001.WERKS = MAS001.WERKS(+) AND INV001.WERKS = MAS003.WERKS(+) AND INV001.STOR_LOC_CD = MAS003.STOR_LOC_CD(+) AND INV001.DOC_ID = #{DOC_ID}
UPDATE TB_INV001 SET APVR_STA = #{APVR_STA},CFRM_DATE=sysdate WHERE DOC_ID=#{DOC_ID}

SELECT A.WAREKY AS "WAREKY", A.COMPKY AS "COMPKY", A.NAME01 AS "NAME01", A.NAME02 AS "NAME02", A.ADDR01 AS "ADDR01", A.POSTCD AS "POSTCD", A.FAXTL1 AS "FAXTL1", A.TELN01 AS "TELN01", A.WADM01 AS "WADM01", A.WADN01 AS "WADN01" FROM WAHMA A WHERE 1 = 1 AND WAREKY = #{SES_WAREKY} AND ROWNUM = 1

SELECT Q020.INSP_ITEM_GRP_CD, Q021.MATNR, --품목코드 M001.MATNR_NM, --품목 M001.MATNR_SPEC, --규격 Q020.LOT_NO, --Lot No (SELECT SUM(EA_QTY) FROM TB_WRK001 WHERE WERKS = Q020.WERKS AND LOT_NO = Q020.LOT_NO AND MATNR = Q020.MATNR) AS "QTY", -- 수량 M016.INSP_ITEM_NM, --항목명 M016.MSRM_UNIT, --측정단위 M016.INSP_SPEC, --시험규격 M016.STD_VAL, --기준값 M016.UPP_VAL, --상한값 M016.LOW_VAL, --하한값 M016.STD_SEL, --기준선택값 M016.INSP_STD_1, --검사기준(1) M016.INSP_STD_2, --검사기준(2) Q021.RST_VAL, --결과값(숫자) Q021.RST_SEL, --결과값(선택) Q021.RST_TXT, --결과값(문자열) Q021.RMK, --특이사항 (SELECT CDESC1 FROM CMCDV WHERE CMCDKY = 'FITYN' AND CMCDVL = Q021.FIT_YN) AS "FIT_YN" --적합여부(Y/N) FROM TB_QLT021 Q021, (SELECT M016.INSP_ITEM_GRP_CD, M016.INSP_ITEM_CD, M014.INSP_ITEM_NM, M014.PROD_GRP_CD, M014.MID_CAT_NM, M014.BIG_CAT_NM, (SELECT CDESC1 FROM CMCDV WHERE CMCDKY = 'INPTDIV' AND CMCDVL = M014.INPT_DIV) AS "INPT_DIV", (SELECT CDESC1 FROM CMCDV WHERE CMCDKY = 'MSRMUNIT' AND CMCDVL = M014.MSRM_CYC) AS "MSRM_CYC", M014.MSRM_ACC, --측정차수 M014.NECSY_YN, -- 필수입력 여부 (SELECT CDESC1 FROM CMCDV WHERE CMCDKY = 'INPTTYP' AND CMCDVL = M014.INPT_TYP) AS "INPT_TYP", (SELECT CDESC1 FROM CMCDV WHERE CMCDKY = 'INPTMTD' AND CMCDVL = M014.INPT_MTD) AS "INPT_MTD", M014.MSRM_MTD, -- 측정방법 M014.MSRM_UNIT,-- 측정단위 M014.INSP_SPEC, M014.DISP_SEQ, M016.MATNR, M016.WERKS, M016.STD_VAL, M016.UPP_VAL, M016.LOW_VAL, M016.STD_SEL, M016.INSP_STD_1, M016.INSP_STD_2 FROM TB_MAS016 M016, TB_MAS014 M014 WHERE M016.INSP_ITEM_GRP_CD = M014.INSP_ITEM_GRP_CD(+) AND M016.INSP_ITEM_CD = M014.INSP_ITEM_CD(+) AND M016.INSP_ITEM_GRP_CD = 'H3' AND M014.INSP_REP_YN = 'Y' AND M016.MATNR = #{MATNR} AND M016.WERKS = #{WERKS} ) M016, TB_QLT020 Q020, TB_MAS001 M001 WHERE Q021.INSP_ITEM_GRP_CD = M016.INSP_ITEM_GRP_CD(+) AND Q021.INSP_ITEM_CD = M016.INSP_ITEM_CD(+) AND Q021.MATNR = M016.MATNR(+) AND Q021.WERKS = M016.WERKS(+) AND Q021.INSP_ITEM_GRP_CD = Q020.INSP_ITEM_GRP_CD(+) AND Q021.MATNR = Q020.MATNR(+) AND Q021.WERKS = Q020.WERKS(+) AND Q021.MSRM_DATE = Q020.MSRM_DATE(+) AND Q021.PRC_SEQNO = Q020.PRC_SEQNO(+) AND Q020.MATNR = M001.MATNR(+) AND Q020.WERKS = M001.WERKS(+) AND Q021.INSP_ITEM_GRP_CD = 'H3' AND Q021.MATNR = #{MATNR} AND Q021.WERKS = #{WERKS} AND Q021.MSRM_DATE = TO_DATE(#{MSRM_DATE},'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND Q021.PRC_SEQNO = TO_NUMBER(#{PRC_SEQNO}) ORDER BY M016.DISP_SEQ
